Behind The Mists Beta - Early Access Test

We are excited to invite you to the Beta Test of Behind The Mists! This is your chance to explore the mysterious world before the official release.

🔹 What's New in This Beta?

Optimized performance for a smoother experience
New areas to explore and secrets to uncover
Improved AI behavior and game mechanics
